title: Sunday Norwegian Fritters
description: A delicious and unique twist on traditional fritters, inspired by Norwegian cuisine with an Indian twist.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, egg, and buttermilk until smooth.
2. Stir in crushed rolls and chopped fritters (if using).
3. Heat a non-stick pan or griddle over medium heat.
4. Using a tablespoon, scoop the batter onto the pan.
5. Cook for 2-3 minutes, until the bottom is golden brown.
6. Flip and cook for another 2 minutes.
7. Repeat until all the batter is used up.
8. Serve warm with your favorite chutney or aioli.
